simple.meaning: קִינָה (qîynâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 18 times across 2 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Amos, beginning at 2 Samuel 1:17. Its contexts include family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִינָה (H7015).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
